description: This file defines an abstract base class Ext.ux.grid.filter.Filter for implementing various grid filters within the Ext JS library. It includes properties, constructor, event handling, and template methods for subclasses to customize filtering behavior.

classes.name: Ext.ux.grid.filter.Filter
classes.description: Abstract base class for grid filter implementations in Ext JS, providing event mechanisms and template methods for subclasses.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the filter by removing event listeners and the associated menu.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Template method for initializing the filter; meant to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value/state of the filter; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the filter's value/state; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: isActivatable
methods.description: Determines if the filter can be activated based on current configuration.

methods.name: getSerialArgs
methods.description: Returns serialized filter data for server transmission.

methods.name: validateRecord
methods.description: Validates a data record against the filter criteria.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Returns serialized filter data and fires the 'serialize' event.

methods.name: fireUpdate
methods.description: Fires an 'update' event if the filter is active and recomputes its active state.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the filter's active state and fires 'activate' or 'deactivate' events accordingly.
